reason: A UI-only sidebar plugin that displays Beijing-time peak or off-peak pricing status, with periodic local updates and bilingual text.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏显示基于北京时间的峰谷定价时段徽章，并支持中英文界面切换。
summaries.en: Displays a Beijing-time peak or off-peak pricing badge in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar with Chinese and English interface text.

capabilities: Displays a peak and off-peak pricing status badge in the sidebar
Updates the displayed time period every 30 seconds
Switches interface text between Chinese and English using the host locale
Uses no network requests, persistent state, or stored data according to the README
